## Evidence and validation

What was observed? What was the vehicle capture age? Did the value match the actual vehicle or myAudi? For an explicitly authorized action, distinguish HTTP acceptance from physical confirmation. Include a reviewed portable definition if available.

Do not post credentials, callback URLs, tokens, VINs, locations, private trips, raw responses or full diagnostics wrappers. Do not run speculative commands or arbitrary endpoint scans.

See the [contribution guide](https://github.com/audiconnect/audi_connect_ha/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the review process.
